name: Seaway
tag: Run the shipping lanes of a sea full of islands and keep the cargo moving
title: Seaway

text.TAG: Draw shipping lines between island ports. Ships sail round the coasts carrying cargo where it is needed, before a port overflows
text.FREE: Endless sea: every boat, unlimited ships and no game over
text.WATCH: A tour of busy seas: archipelagos, lagoons and straits
text.FOOT: Every week you get a new ship and choose an upgrade. Cargo wants a kind of port, not a particular one: it changes ships to get there.
text.FIND: Find a port, line or upgrade…
text.HINT: Drag from a port to another to draw a shipping line · right-drag to look around
